name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: Feed it a podcast or long video link, and it automatically cuts it into short clips with captions, covers, and ready-to-post text for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
buyer: A podcaster or online course creator who knows short clips drive growth but can't afford to pay a video editor every week.
business_use_cases: A podcaster runs every new episode through it to get 5-10 ready-to-post short clips for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts without hiring an editor.
A social media agency uses it as the first-pass engine for a 'long-form to short-form repurposing' service it resells to multiple podcast and course clients.
An online course creator turns lecture recordings into bite-sized promotional clips to drive course sales on social media.

money_ideas.idea: Launch a 'send us your podcast link, get 10 short clips back in 24 hours' productized subscription service for podcasters.
Offer one-off bulk repurposing packages for creators sitting on a backlog of old long-form content.

steal_this: This weekend, set it up and offer 3 free sample clips to 10 podcasters you find on Spotify or YouTube, then pitch a monthly repurposing subscription to the ones who respond.
